settings.advanced.title: Advanced Options
settings.advanced.subtitle: These options affect video generation behavior in the AI Director panel.
settings.advanced.visualContinuity.title: Visual continuity
settings.advanced.visualContinuity.desc: Automatically passes the previous scene's tail frame as reference to keep style and character appearance consistent.
settings.advanced.resumeGeneration.title: Resume generation
settings.advanced.resumeGeneration.desc: Resume from the last position after interruption instead of restarting from scratch.
settings.advanced.resumeGeneration.hint: Recommended to reduce progress loss on network/API timeout.
settings.advanced.contentModeration.desc: When sensitive content is detected, skip that scene and continue with others.
settings.advanced.contentModeration.hint: Recommended to avoid full pipeline interruption.
settings.advanced.autoModelSwitch.title: Auto model switch
settings.advanced.autoModelSwitch.desc: Use text-to-video (t2v) for first scene, image-to-video (i2v) for following scenes.
settings.advanced.autoModelSwitch.hint: Off by default; useful only when multiple models are configured.
settings.advanced.notice: If you're unsure about these options, keep default settings.
settings.imageHost.title: Image Host Configuration
settings.imageHost.subtitle: Image hosts store temporary images during video generation (e.g. tail frame extraction, frame passing).
settings.imageHost.notice1: Image hosts are used for temporary images in visual continuity features. Without configuration, cross-scene frame passing can be limited.
settings.imageHost.notice2: SCDN is enabled by default (no key required). ImgBB is disabled by default; enable and test manually if needed.

settings.storage.desktopOnly: This feature is only available in desktop builds.
